 Official Juventus team to face Fiorentina – Mckennie and Boga start 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Juventus travel to Florence to face Fiorentina in an important Serie A encounter, with Luciano Spalletti’s side determined to secure another victory before the international break. This is the team just announced by the manager.
 Juventus team to face Fiorentina
 OneFootball Videos
 The victories over Napoli and AZ have provided encouragement after a difficult spell, and Juventus will be eager to demonstrate that they are finally finding the consistency required to compete at the highest level. They know there is still plenty of work to do, but another three points would represent an important step forward.
 The Old Lady have enough quality to win this type of match, although their recent record against Fiorentina suggests they cannot afford to underestimate their opponents. They will need to deliver a disciplined performance if they are to leave Florence with the result they want.
 Fiorentina present a difficult test
 La Viola have enjoyed the better of recent meetings between these sides, having avoided defeat in their last four encounters with Juventus and winning two of those fixtures. That record will give the home supporters plenty of encouragement as they prepare to welcome the Bianconeri.
 Fiorentina have also started to improve after a difficult opening to the season. Their recent performances suggest they are becoming more competitive, and they have players capable of troubling Juventus if the visitors fail to perform at their best.
 Spalletti’s men should therefore expect a tougher challenge than the ones they faced against Napoli and AZ. Fiorentina will be motivated to continue their positive run in this fixture, particularly with the opportunity to claim an important result in front of their own supporters.
 Juventus must maintain their progress
 Despite the challenge, Juventus have reasons to believe they can secure another victory. Their recent performances have shown signs of improvement, and the confidence gained from two consecutive wins could help them approach this encounter positively.
 The Bianconeri will also understand how important it is to finish this period with a strong result. Heading into the international break with three successive victories would provide a significant boost and give Spalletti further encouragement about the direction of his team.
